neighbours.label: an additive or degree adverb that qualifies a claim ("partly because", "especially", "Furthermore", "largely")
fire: Sales fell last quarter, partly because two stores were closed for repairs.
The trail is slippery, especially after a night of heavy rain.
The device is light. Furthermore, its battery lasts for two full days.
Her success was partly due to luck and partly to stubbornness.
Children enjoy the exhibit, especially the room with the dinosaur bones.
The strike failed, largely because the drivers refused to join.
The flat is small. Moreover, it faces a very noisy street.
Attendance dropped, partly as a result of the new ticket prices.
